purpose: Independently test the rate-conditioned regenerative-throttling effect and then test whether the spatial rootedness-congruence term explains the high-rate recruitment deficit.

frozen_state_rootedness_ablation.definition: At each stored state, recompute recruitment hazard with local_rootedness_weight set to zero while leaving the particle state and every other parameter unchanged.
frozen_state_rootedness_ablation.causal_scope: This isolates the instantaneous contribution of the rootedness term to recruitment hazard at a fixed state; it is not a dynamic intervention.

primary_rate_interaction_predictions.prediction: Mean day240 treatment-minus-control rooted-membership effect is negative at both recruitment rates.
primary_rate_interaction_predictions.pass_gate: Both normal 95% upper bounds are below zero.

primary_rate_interaction_predictions.prediction: Mean day240 treatment-minus-control eligible-recruitment-mass effect is positive at both recruitment rates.
primary_rate_interaction_predictions.pass_gate: Both normal 95% lower bounds are above zero.

primary_rate_interaction_predictions.prediction: The day240 treatment-minus-control cumulative-recruitment effect is lower at 0.125 than at 0.03125.
primary_rate_interaction_predictions.pass_gate: The paired high-minus-low normal 95% upper bound is below zero.

primary_rate_interaction_predictions.prediction: The day360 treatment-minus-control cumulative-recruitment effect is lower at 0.125 than at 0.03125.
primary_rate_interaction_predictions.pass_gate: The paired high-minus-low normal 95% upper bound is below zero.

primary_rate_interaction_predictions.prediction: The day360 rooted-stock deficit is larger at 0.125 than at 0.03125.
primary_rate_interaction_predictions.pass_gate: The paired high-minus-low normal 95% upper bound is below zero.

primary_rate_interaction_predictions.prediction: The day360 capital effect is more positive at 0.125 than at 0.03125 because fewer realized recruits consume less equipment capital.
primary_rate_interaction_predictions.pass_gate: The paired high-minus-low normal 95% lower bound is above zero.

rootedness_mechanism_predictions.prediction: At day240, the high-rate treatment-minus-control rootedness-congruence logit contribution is negative.
At day240, removing the rootedness term from the frozen-state hazard makes the high-rate treatment/control log-hazard contrast less negative.
rootedness_mechanism_predictions.pass_gate: Normal 95% upper bound of rootedness_log_hazard_contribution below zero.

rootedness_mechanism_predictions.prediction: The rootedness hazard contribution is more negative at the high rate than at the low rate.
rootedness_mechanism_predictions.pass_gate: Paired high-minus-low normal 95% upper bound below zero.

rootedness_mechanism_predictions.prediction: The high-rate rootedness logit contribution is larger in absolute mean magnitude than the compatibility contribution.
rootedness_mechanism_predictions.pass_gate: abs(mean rootedness contribution) > 5 * abs(mean compatibility contribution).

capital_replication.prediction: Across paired cells, treatment-minus-control cumulative recruitment and capital effects remain strongly negatively associated.
capital_replication.pass_gate: Pearson r <= -0.95 at day360 across the 48 rate-by-seed paired effects.

promotion_rule.if_rate_interaction_passes_but_rootednes: Retain rate-conditioned regenerative throttling and reject or narrow the rootedness explanation.
promotion_rule.if_rate_interaction_fails: Do not promote regenerative throttling; preserve the development result as non-replicated.

guard: Synthetic Pineland mechanism confirmation only; no empirical irregular-warfare claim is licensed by this test.
